assessment_summary: Step 0359 is not justified as written. After conditioning on a good M_0, its left-hand side is deterministic because it consists of expectations over ξ and ξ′, but its right-hand side contains the random quantity |X_ξ-X_*|^j rather than its expectation. The preceding bound (0353) only establishes the corresponding inequality with E|X_ξ-X_*|^j.
